rationale: B is more useful because it gives a clear recommendation, identifies a live alternative, and provides a concrete staged launch sequence with timing and stakeholder counts. A gestures at validator-first but leaves key fields effectively blank and offers little comparative analysis among the listed options. Neither writeup handles uncertainty or revisit triggers well, but B still better supports action by specifying how to execute the recommendation and why broad social launch is weaker. Quantitative support is modest in both, though B’s counts and timeline are more decision-relevant.
